subject: [hw] lead review V40: 1 HIGH for the phone (VCU_GET_LOG_OBJECT must block)
body: vcu/n2vcu.c vcu_get_log_object() returns immediately; the kernel blocks: mtk_vcu.c:521-545 vcu_log_get() does wait_event_freezable(vcu->vdec_log_get_wq, atomic_read(&vcu->vdec_log_got)) and clears the flag after the copy. vpud has a thread that loops on this ioctl: IV measured 805506 calls in 5 s, i.e. one interpreted guest thread spinning forever = a full CPU core on the phone and it starves the encode thread under the interpreter. Required: block on a condition variable until (a) the AP side sets a log (add n2vcu_ap_set_log(vcu, text) which stores log_info, sets log_got=1, broadcasts; it mirrors the kernel vcu_set_log path; nobody needs to call it yet), or (b) the device is closed / n2vcu_destroy / the calling cpu has stop_request set (poll the flag with a 100 ms timed wait) -> return -EINTR (guest sees -1/EINTR, as a signal would give). Clear log_got after a successful copy. Test: a thread in GET_LOG_OBJECT stays blocked for 300 ms, returns after n2vcu_ap_set_log with the text, and returns -EINTR on stop_request within 200 ms; TSan clean. Also fix R1 F14 (64-bit mmap offset overflow in the MAP_SHMEM_* range checks: compare with subtraction, not addition).
